visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair, wearing a light grey knit cardigan over a black high-neck shirt, sits in a black ergonomic office chair. He is positioned in a well-lit indoor room with beige walls. Behind him, a vibrant yellow multi-tiered metal shelf is filled with various colorful LEGO models, including a miniature Statue of Liberty and a castle. He holds a black bag of potato chips in his left hand, looking slightly to the side with a conversational expression. (2) The scene cuts to a screen recording of a mobile device displaying the "Taiwan Bar" YouTube channel. The interface shows a white background with black text and various video thumbnails featuring animated historical characters and vibrant colors. The view scrolls downwards, revealing titles related to history and rights. A yellow bar with a black icon appears at the top. (3) The camera returns to the man in the office setting. He is now looking directly at the camera, gesturing with his right hand to emphasize his points. A small, simplified cartoon avatar of a woman with black hair and a smiling face is anchored at the bottom of the frame. Yellow text overlays appear periodically above the man's head, and the lighting remains bright and consistent across his face. (4) A static screenshot of a Facebook post is shown. The interface is the classic blue and white design. The post features several comments from users with names of ancient historical figures like Cao Cao and Liu Bei, each with their own profile picture. The text is dense and arranged in a typical social media thread format. (5) The man is back on screen, leaning slightly forward. He continues to speak while holding the chip bag. Large, bold yellow and white text overlays pop onto the screen to highlight key terms. A graphic logo for "Story Studio" featuring a stylized "S" in a circle appears as a floating element for a brief moment. (6) A collection of four colorful graphic cards is displayed in a 2x2 grid. Each card features a different mascot character representing a Taiwan MRT line, such as a blue character for the Bannan Line and an orange one for the Zhonghe-Xinlu Line. The man's face is seen talking in a small circular inset at the center. (7) There is a very brief, cinematic cutaway to a dimly lit scene. A muscular man wearing a headgear and boxing gloves stands in what appears to be a boxing ring. The lighting is high-contrast with dark shadows, creating a serious and intense atmosphere. The camera angle is slightly low, looking up at the figure. (8) Final scene shows the man back in his office chair. He is laughing slightly and looks relaxed. The cartoon female avatar remains at the bottom. The camera is steady at eye-level. He makes a final hand gesture towards the camera as the video concludes. The LEGO models on the yellow shelf are clearly visible in the background.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an informative commentary and storytelling piece that explores the phenomenon of 'historical figure' accounts trending on the Threads social media platform. By drawing parallels to similar marketing trends on Facebook from ten years ago, the creator provides historical context and discusses platform strategies regarding fake or role-playing accounts.
